name: Casey's General Stores
description: Casey's runs 2,944 convenience stores (April 30, 2026), mostly in small Midwest towns, and makes its profit inside the store, not at the pump. Fuel brings drivers in ($10.6B of $17.6B revenue) at a thin margin (42.6 cents a gallon on 3.5B gallons), while prepared food (mainly pizza) earns a 58.6% gross margin and packaged groceries 35.8%. FY2026 net income was $714.4M (EPS $19.16, EBITDA $1,484M). Inside same-store sales rose 4.2% and inside margin was about 42%. Growth comes from about 80 new stores a year (40 built, 40 acquired in FY2026), the Fikes Wholesale/CEFCO acquisition (added $1,034M revenue in FY2026, with about 50 CEFCO stores being converted to Casey's), and the guidance of 120+ new stores in FY2027.

businessLines.name: Retail fuel
businessLines.how: Sells gasoline and diesel at a per-gallon margin (42.6 cents in FY2026); low margin but brings in the traffic that buys inside items.

businessLines.name: Grocery and general merchandise
businessLines.how: Packaged goods, beverages, tobacco and general items in the store; 35.8% gross margin.

businessLines.name: Prepared food and dispensed beverage
businessLines.how: Pizza (made in-store, often whole pizzas), sandwiches, donuts, appetizers and fountain drinks; 58.6% gross margin, the highest in the stores.

businessLines.name: Other
businessLines.how: Wholesale fuel and other sales (includes Fikes Wholesale, bought FY2025), car wash and other; 24.5% margin.

brands.name: CEFCO
brands.note: Acquired with Fikes Wholesale in FY2025; about 50 stores being remodelled into Casey's in FY2026
